sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: NextChat is a light, fast chat app for AI models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek. You deploy your own copy on Vercel, Docker or a desktop app, add your API key, and get a ChatGPT-style interface.
sixtySeconds.problem: Using several AI models usually means several paid chat apps. NextChat gives you one self-hosted interface that talks to the providers you have keys for, with chats stored locally in your browser.
whoFor: People with API keys who want their own chat interface
Teams sharing one private chat app behind a password
Users of self-hosted models via LocalAI or similar
Anyone wanting a small desktop chat client
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a quick, free, self-hosted chat UI with one-click Vercel deploys and many providers. You pay the AI providers for usage through your own keys.
requirements: An API key for at least one provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others)
Or Docker 20+, or a Vercel account

overview: NextChat (formerly ChatGPT Next Web) is a web chat client you host yourself. It supports OpenAI, Azure, Google Gemini, Anthropic, Baidu and other providers through environment variables, and is compatible with self-hosted models such as LocalAI.

Chats are stored locally in the browser. It renders markdown with LaTeX and mermaid, streams responses, compresses long chat history to save tokens, and lets you create prompt templates called masks. Plugins, artifacts and realtime chat are also supported, and MCP can be enabled at build time.
You can deploy it in one click on Vercel, run the Docker image, or download the small desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. A CODE environment variable adds a simple access password.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from NextChat's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Pull and run the image
steps.body: Replace the key and password with your own.
steps.code:
docker pull yidadaa/chatgpt-next-web
docker run -d -p 3000:3000 \
   -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-xxxx \
   -e CODE=your-password \
   yidadaa/chatgpt-next-web

steps.title: Deploy
steps.body: Use the Deploy with Vercel button in the README and fill in OPENAI_API_KEY and CODE.

environment.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environment.description: Your OpenAI key; join several with commas.

environment.name: BASE_URL
environment.description: Override the OpenAI API URL, for example for a proxy.

environment.name: ENABLE_MCP
environment.description: Set to true before building to enable MCP.

firstRun.title: Open http://localhost:3000 and enter your access password

troubleshooting.solution: Delete the repo Vercel created, fork the project instead and redeploy, then enable Upstream Sync in the fork's Actions.
Update the fork manually using GitHub's syncing-a-fork steps.
Redeploy after changing the CODE variable.
Set BASE_URL to a proxy you trust.
